content.comment_body: I'm experiencing the same issue. I can't see the analog input (in this case, PT100) in the panel HMI.

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Could you share more details about your setup? How are you transmitting the analog value to the HMI? Which [product_name] are you using and what [product_name] version do you have installed? Which HMI model do you have? Is it a [company_name] HMI? If possible, please upload your [product_name] project and HMI configuration as a zipped file.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to display analog input from a PT100 sensor on an HMI panel when working with [company_name] [product_name] hardware. The absence of analog data on the HMI suggests that there may be a configuration, communication, or compatibility issue between the [product_name] module and the HMI panel. The lack of details about the system's setup is making troubleshooting more difficult for other users, potentially causing frustration.
